title: 2027 Ram 3500 Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Ram 3500 is essentially a carryover model, but gets new exterior colors, expanded appearance package availability, and an increased Gross Vehicle Weight Rating in some configurations.
body_markdown:
The Ram Heavy Duty lineup was all-new in 2019, and received a significant refresh in 2025. The 3500 sits above the 2500 and is officially classified as a one-ton, Class 3 truck. Primary competitors include the Ford F-350, the Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD, and the GMC Sierra 3500HD. The 2027 Ram 3500 has five trims: Tradesman, Big Horn, Laramie, Limited, and Longhorn.

## What’s New for the 2027 Ram 3500


The Ram 3500 got a significant mid-cycle refresh in 2025 that included new trim-specific grilles, revised exterior design elements, a new eight-speed transmission for the diesel engine, improved towing tech, a refreshed interior, a larger standard infotainment screen, powertrain updates, and more standard safety tech. As a result, the 2027 model is essentially a carryover with a few minor updates. This includes a Gross Vehicle Weight Rating increase of 400 pounds in some configurations with the 6.4-liter V8 engine, new exterior colors, expanded appearance package availability, and some trim refinements.


## Design


The Ram 3500 has a bold upright grille with trim-specific details, so buyers can differentiate between the trims at a glance. This heavy-duty truck has multiple cab and bed configurations across the trim lineup. Base models are available in a regular cab, 8-foot-bed configurations as well as crew cab with 6-foot-4-inch- and 8-foot-bed configurations. Top trims drop the regular cab but add a Mega Cab configuration with the 6-foot-4-inch bed. This truck also offers single- and dual-rear-wheel options. Even though it's a heavy-duty truck, it offers a number of trim-dependent appearance packages, including Chrome Appearance and Bumper packages, a Sport Appearance package, and the Night Edition. Standard wheels are 18 inches, but 17- and 20-inch wheels are available.


## Powertrain


For 2027, the Ram 3500 has just two powertrains: a 6.4-liter Hemi V8 that makes 405 horsepower and a 6.7-liter Cummins high-output turbodiesel with 430 hp. While the horsepower ratings aren’t wildly different, the torque is, at 429 pound-feet and 1,075 lb-ft respectively. Maximum towing capacity with the diesel is 37,020 pounds versus 18,140 pounds with the V8. Although the EPA doesn’t have to test fuel economy on the 3500 because of its size, anecdotal reports state that the combined average for the V8 is 11 to 14 mpg, while the diesel gets 17 to 22 mpg.


## Interior


With the 2025 refresh, the Ram 3500's interior got an updated center console and upgraded tech. Depending on the cab configuration, the 3500 seats three to six occupants. The regular cab only has a bench seat option, seating three, but both the crew cab and Mega Cab models have a front bucket seat option, which reduces seating to five. Despite its name and size, the Mega Cab doesn’t offer standout rear-seat legroom. While it has more legroom than the crew cab on the 3500, it has less legroom than the crew cab versions of the Ford and GM HD trucks. What it does offer is behind-seat, in-cabin storage and reclining rear seats. Standard seating surfaces are vinyl, with cloth and leather available. A sunroof is not standard on any trim, but is available for Laramie, Limited, and Longhorn models. Outside of the truck bed, the 3500 has a number of in-cabin storage options. The rear seats can fold flat to create a flat load floor, and in some models the rear seat cushions lift out to reveal storage compartments. Plus, similar to the smaller 1500, the 3500 also offers a weatherproof and lockable RamBox bed storage option.


## Technology


The Ram 3500 got a big tech overhaul in 2025, and that included standard upgrades such as the Uconnect 5 operating system, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, and over-the-air (OTA) updates. The base screen in the Tradesman is 8.4 inches, but a 12-inch vertical screen is available in the bottom two trims and standard starting on the Laramie. A 14.5-inch vertical screen is available on the Laramie and standard on the top two trims. In terms of audio, a six-speaker (four speakers in the regular cab) system is standard, but nine-speaker Alpine and 17-speaker Harman Kardon sound systems are available. Other available tech features include a rear-camera mirror, a surround-view camera system, a 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot (subscription required), a 10.25-inch passenger screen, a 12.3-inch digital cluster, Ram connected services (subscription required), navigation, and dual-zone automatic climate control.

## Safety


Standard safety features include adaptive cruise control, tire-pressure monitoring, full-speed collision warning, and a backup camera with dynamic guidelines. Available safety features include automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitors with trailer coverage, lane-keep assist, front and rear parking sensors, and a rear-seat reminder. Neither the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration nor the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety had crash tested any version of the Ram 3500 at the time of writing.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Ram 3500 went on sale in mid-2026, and at the time of writing, the least expensive 3500 was the Tradesman with the regular cab, 8-foot bed, 4x2 configuration, which started at $52,135, including a $2,795 destination fee. The most expensive Tradesman is the crew cab, 8-foot bed, and 4x4 configuration, which starts at $58,885. The starting price ranges for the Big Horn trim are $55,885 to $62,635. With more standard tech and features and the lack of a regular cab option, the Laramie crew cab, 8-foot bed, 4x2 configuration starts at $67,590. Upgrading to the Mega Cab with the 6-foot-4-inch bed starts at $84,530. Starting prices for the Limited and Longhorn trims range from $79,600 to $96,829. There are a slew of options and packages for the 3500 that can add significant costs to every trim, the most expensive of which is the diesel engine. It’s only available starting at the Laramie trim, and costs $12,495.
